profile_meta.name: aurora-dark-task-ui
profile_meta.derived_from: two screenshots of a to-do web app (hero state and scrolled state)
profile_meta.note: Colors are suggested equivalents, not exact matches. Image and task text content intentionally excluded.
profile_meta.purpose: Give an AI coding assistant enough context to build new screens in the same visual language

design_style.mood: calm, focused, modern, slightly playful through the gradient only
design_style.density: airy; generous padding, one idea per section
design_style.shape_language: large rounded corners on cards (20-24px), full pills for chips, tabs and buttons, circles for icon buttons and the primary add action
design_style.depth_model: flat layered surfaces: near-black page, slightly lighter cards, no heavy shadows; depth comes from the gradient, blur and opacity
signature_elements: Full-bleed blurred mesh/aurora gradient at the top of the page that fades into the near-black background
Oversized, ultra-light, semi-transparent date display used as the hero headline
One white circular add button as the single high-emphasis action
Active states are always white fill with dark text
design_style.restraint_rule: The gradient is the only colorful element. Everything else is neutral black, gray and white, with small semantic accents.

gradient_aurora.type: blurred mesh of 3 to 4 radial blobs layered over the background
gradient_aurora.texture: optional subtle film grain/noise at 4-8% opacity
gradient_aurora.height: about 55-60vh in hero state, about 100px visible strip in compact state

usage_rules: Never use more than one accent color per component.
Text over the gradient must be either pure white or pure near-black with large size and weight.
Semantic colors (red, blue, green) only appear as small icons or dots, never as large fills.
Swap the gradient hues freely, but keep 3 to 4 saturated hues that blend smoothly.

typography.font_family: Geometric/humanist sans-serif such as Inter, Figtree, Outfit or Plus Jakarta Sans. Fallback: system-ui, sans-serif

hero_display.behavior: shrinks into the compact top bar on scroll

section_label.has_count: count shown after the label in a smaller, dimmer style

spacing_and_shape.borders: Almost none on solid cards. Dashed 1px border only on empty-state containers.
spacing_and_shape.shadows: none or very soft; rely on surface color contrast

layout_structure.pattern: Top navigation + gradient hero + centered two-column content

hero_state.description: Top of page: gradient fills the top, large date display, white circular add button below it, then content.
regions: Top bar (transparent over the gradient): wordmark left, centered category tabs, two circular outlined icon buttons on the right (settings, theme toggle)
Primary action: white circle button with plus icon, centered, about 88px
Section label 'today' list, followed by the two-column area

compact_state.description: After scrolling: the hero collapses to a sticky glass top bar.
regions: Left: mini calendar badge (month abbreviation over day number) + one-line summary of counts
Center: white pill 'New task' button with plus icon
Right: plain text category tabs; active tab is white with a thin white indicator line at the very top edge of the screen
compact_state.bar_style: background topbar_glass, backdrop-filter blur(16px), height 56-64px, sticky top 0

content_grid.right_column: sticky stack: calendar card, then info/integration card
content_grid.mobile: single column; calendar moves below the list or into a collapsible; tabs become horizontally scrollable

layout_structure.alignment: Hero and top tabs centered; all content text left-aligned

top_tabs.behavior: filters tasks by category; 'All' and 'High priority' are included as filters

icon_button.style: 1px outlined or ghost, icon centered, white icon

primary_add_button.hero_variant: 88px white circle, dark plus icon, no text
primary_add_button.compact_variant: white pill with plus icon and the label 'New task', dark text, height 44-48px

layout: Row 1: title (semi-bold) followed by a small red outlined circle icon with an exclamation mark when high priority
Row 2: one-line description in secondary text
Row 3: meta row with pill chips (category, priority) and then plain muted date/time text

states.stacked_scroll: cards passing under the sticky bar fade and blur with reduced opacity

calendar_card.header: month + year centered, with single and double chevron buttons on each side (previous/next month and year)
calendar_card.day_cell: centered number, large hit area (about 48px), no borders
calendar_card.today_or_selected: white rounded square (12px) with dark text
calendar_card.days_with_tasks: optional small dot under the number

info_card.content: bold short heading, one or two lines of secondary text, then stacked outlined pill buttons
info_card.button: pill with 1px subtle border, colored line icon on the left, white label

empty_state.text: single centered sentence in muted text
empty_state.tone: plain statement, no apology, e.g. 'Nothing scheduled this week.'

components.section_header: uppercase tracked label + dim count, margin-top 48px, margin-bottom 16px

interaction_and_motion.scroll: Hero date and gradient compress into the sticky glass bar; this is the one signature motion
interaction_and_motion.theme_toggle: 44px round outlined icon button in the top right (sun icon in dark mode, moon icon in light mode); dark is the default design; the choice is remembered
interaction_and_motion.reduced_motion: disable scroll-linked scaling and parallax, keep instant state changes
avoid: animated gradients that distract from tasks

content_voice.case: sentence case for UI text; uppercase only for section labels
content_voice.empty_states: state the fact in one sentence
content_voice.summary_line: one compact sentence with counts, e.g. 'N tasks today, N this week'

accessibility.min_text_contrast: 4.5:1 (check text placed over the gradient; add a dark scrim if needed)
accessibility.focus_visible: 2px white outline with 2px offset on all interactive elements
accessibility.do_not_rely_on_color_alone: priority is shown by icon plus label, not only by red

light_theme_tokens.note: Same components and layout as dark; only colours change. Active state flips to near-black fill with white text.

replication_instructions_for_ai: Build dark-mode first on a #0a0a0a page; define all colors as CSS variables on :root.
Create the aurora with 3 to 4 absolutely positioned radial-gradient blobs, blurred 80-120px, then overlay a gradient that fades the bottom edge into the background color.
Use one hero element (a huge, thin, semi-transparent display text) and one primary action (white circle). Do not add other bright elements.
Use pill shapes for tabs, chips and buttons; 24px radius for cards and panels.
Active/selected state is always white background with near-black text.
Keep cards flat: solid surface color, no borders, no heavy shadows.
Use uppercase, letter-spaced, muted labels only for section headings, with a dim count beside them.
Lay out content as a 2:1 grid with a sticky right column; collapse to one column under 900px.
On scroll, collapse the hero into a sticky 60px glass bar containing a mini date badge, a one-line summary, the New task pill and text tabs.
Empty sections use a dashed-border container with one muted sentence.
Keep copy short and plain; sentence case; verb-first buttons.
Vary the gradient hues per project if desired, but keep the neutral palette and layout rules unchanged.
cursor_prompt_template: Use design-system.json as the single source of truth for visual style. Build [FEATURE] following its color_tokens, typography, spacing_and_shape, layout_structure and components. Do not invent new colors, radii or font sizes outside the tokens. Keep the gradient hero and the white-pill active state. Output plain HTML/CSS/JS unless told otherwise.
